metric_semantics.signed_bias: prediction minus continuous GT; negative means underestimation
metric_semantics.mode: maximum bin probability center, not maximum density for unequal width bins
metric_semantics.entropy: -sum(p log p)/log(48), categorical entropy with fixed LID bins
metric_semantics.window_mass: sum of probability at centers within inclusive GT +/- window; uniform-bin variant separately named
metric_semantics.distribution_expected_absolute_error: sum_k p_k abs(center_k-GT); distinct from abs(sum_k p_k center_k-GT)
metric_semantics.multimodality: heuristic: two local maxima >=0.05, separation >=5m, secondary >=25% primary, valley <=50% smaller peak
metric_semantics.in_bev: GT continuous point x[-20,60),y[-30,30),z[-2,4); same masks/rays across models
metric_semantics.bev: matched valid rays and frozen context; continuous oracle, quantized oracle, probability splat, point decoders, pixel prior
metric_semantics.oracle_intervention: privileged diagnostic, never model input or deployable score; frozen heads may be out-of-distribution
metric_semantics.surface: sampled visible point counts only; zero-count cells are not Free and no semantic Occupancy claimed

perturbation_semantics.front_local_mask: front camera central 50% width x 50% height replaced by that image channel mean, all other inputs fixed
perturbation_semantics.rgb_spatial_mean: each view replaced with its own channel mean; destroys spatial evidence but retains color/weather
perturbation_semantics.feature_spatial_shuffle: fixed seed91 pixel permutation after image encoder, shared across cameras, channel vectors preserved; camera MLP unchanged
perturbation_semantics.feature_zero: post-encoder features set zero; camera MLP and downstream biases/priors remain
